newsitem.title: USA: AMC Entertainment offers merger with parent.
newsitem.headline: AMC Entertainment offers merger with parent.

text.p: AMC Entertainment Inc said Thursday its board of directors proposed a merger with Durwood Inc, its corporate parent.

The motion picture theater operator said the proposed merger is one of a series of transactions in accordance with an agreement between AMC Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Stanley Durwood and his children. The Durwood family wants to hold its ownership in the company directly in the form of marketable securities rather than indirectly through Durwood Inc and a family partnership.
AMC plans to hold a special shareholder meeting in late spring or early summer to approve the merger proposal.
AMC shares were down 1/2 Thursday at 19-1/2.
